verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows the Secretary of State publishing, before filing begins, which account, login credential, or identity-proofing steps a founder must complete. The SOS items are only page titles for filing services (formation, annual report, closure), with no stated prerequisites. The account-related lines (docs-17, docs-18) come from the Department of Revenue's business-license page, not the SOS, and only say an account exists, without describing credential or identity-proofing steps.
